question: Materialize the unchanged proposal, mask and descriptor roster for a wholly fresh three-reference family with two adjacent query observations, before applying the already learned temporal scale-vacancy rule.

predecessor.single_change: Transport the frozen temporal scale-vacancy rule unchanged to a wholly fresh family: link adjacent candidate boxes above 0.5 IoU, rank a linked path by mean semantic/local score minus 0.05 times mean nearest-reference log-area distance, and append only its current-frame candidate when exact deduplication leaves a set vacancy below three.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among three target references; normalized foreground patches from DINOv2 ViT-L/14 zero-based block 18 supply query-directed local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches.
frozen_confirmation_rule: preserve layer-18 local minus 0.05 times distance to the nearest of the three reference target log-area fractions
preserve the best semantic/local-fusion candidate constrained to the plurality winning target reference across the adjacent pair

after exact deduplication, if fewer than three candidates remain, append the current-frame member of the best adjacent linked path using link IoU above 0.5 and mean score minus 0.05 mean scale distance

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; confirmation coverage is evaluated only after the frozen contributor, deduplication and temporal-vacancy rule completes.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after reference voting, all preserved contributors, exact deduplication and the frozen adjacent-link vacancy decision are complete.

literature_motivation.use: Motivates linking adjacent detections by overlap and scoring the path rather than each frame independently.

literature_motivation.source: Leveraging Long-Range Temporal Relationships Between Proposals for Video Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Motivates proposal-level temporal consistency while retaining frame-specific candidate evidence.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the five frozen image rows, model bytes, proposals, features, preserved contributors, 0.05 penalties, adjacent link threshold, path score, deterministic tie order, exact deduplication, vacancy condition, set size three or IoU gate
duplicate a query row, use query truth in hypothesis generation or inspect the final metric before freezing the confirmation implementation
retry, rescue or retune this fresh family after the final confirmation result is materialized
claim_boundary: This artifact freezes only the fresh proposal and descriptor roster. It cannot by itself establish the temporal mechanism, whole-rule confirmation, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty, portal ownership, access, safety, waypoint, arrival or handoff.
